'''2016 MPC Mike d'Amboise LS Echo Base Operations''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mike d'Amboise]] at [[2016 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Mike d'Amboise]]
* '''Event:''' [[2016 Match Play Championship]]

* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
